description: This Java class 'RtlSupportProcessor' handles refactoring tasks related to adding RTL (Right-to-Left) support in Android projects. It updates AndroidManifest.xml and layout XML files to support RTL attributes and configurations, including creating versioned resource directories and modifying layout attributes for RTL compatibility.

classes.name: RtlSupportProcessor
classes.description: A refactoring processor that adds RTL support to Android projects by modifying manifest and layout files, creating versioned resource directories, and updating layout attributes for RTL compatibility.

methods.name: initMapMirroredAttributes
methods.description: Initializes the map of attributes that need to be mirrored for RTL support.

methods.name: addManifestRefactoring
methods.description: Adds refactoring hints for updating AndroidManifest.xml to support RTL, including supportsRtl attribute and targetSdkVersion.

methods.name: getLayoutV17
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the '-v17' resource directory for layout files.

methods.name: getLayoutRefactoringForOneDir
methods.description: Processes all layout files in a directory for RTL attribute refactoring.

methods.name: getLayoutRefactoringForOneFile
methods.description: Processes a single layout file for RTL attribute refactoring.

methods.name: getLayoutRefactoringForFile
methods.description: Analyzes a layout PsiFile for attributes that need to be mirrored or adjusted for RTL support.

methods.name: getLayoutRefactoringForTag
methods.description: Analyzes an XML tag in a layout file for RTL attributes to mirror or adjust.

methods.name: performRefactoringForAndroidManifestApplicationTag
methods.description: Sets the supportsRtl attribute to true in the AndroidManifest application tag.

methods.name: performRefactoringForAndroidManifestTargetSdk
methods.description: Sets the targetSdkVersion to 17 in the AndroidManifest.

methods.name: performRefactoringForLayoutFile
methods.description: Performs the actual attribute updates or creates a '-v17' layout file with updated attributes.

methods.name: updateAttributeForElement
methods.description: Updates a specific layout attribute for RTL support, including renaming and value adjustments.

methods.name: updateAttributeValueIfNeeded
methods.description: Adjusts attribute values, especially for padding and gravity, to support RTL.
